name: Inception (Mercury)
description: Diffusion LLMs that generate at ~1,000 tokens/second, with 100M free signup tokens.
overview: Inception's Mercury models use diffusion rather than autoregressive decoding, which is why they stream at roughly 1,000 tokens per second — several times the speed of similarly sized models. New accounts get a 100,000,000-token signup allowance (raised from 10M in July 2026) that is shared across the Mercury 2 family, with 100 requests/minute and no card. Terms permit prompt storage and training by default, with an opt-out in the dashboard.
free_access: 100,000,000 free tokens once, shared across Mercury 2 / 2.5 / 3
No card required; billing only after the balance is spent
notes: The 100M allowance is one-time, not monthly; prompts may train models unless you turn that off.
